title: Design Flaw
text: Design Flaw. Beautiful cake plate. Gave it a three star because there is a flaw in the plate. The defect is very visible, but I needed for the holidays and could not send back.

product_metadata.title: Songbird Pedestal Cake Stand With Dome, 11 inches high by 10 inch wide
features: Dome Cover Protects Food While Displaying It
description: Founded in 1996, Art land is a privately owned manufacturing company that designs, produces, and markets a range of products for the tabletop and home fashion industries. Their product lines focus on mouth blown glassware, ceramic tableware, aluminum serve ware, and stainless steel barware. Art land's elegant designs are great additions to any home.
